changes.text: The required asterisk (`.req`) and the chevron use logical properties (`margin-inline-start`, `border-inline`), so under `dir="rtl"` the asterisk follows the label text and the chevron keeps its gap on the select's side.
Plain-HTML pages can style the same `.ss-select` markup with the generated `dssoca/vanilla.css`.
The focus ring of an invalid field is a `color-mix()` of the `--ss-danger` palette slot (was `rgba(var(--ss-red-rgb), 0.22)`), so it follows an imported palette.

New component: a styled native `<select>` on the Input field chrome, taking flat `options` or `<optgroup>` groups, with `label`, `placeholder`, `hint`, `error`, `invalid`, `required`, `disabled` and `size` props and a bindable `value`.
